title: Examining the Smartphone Theory of Everything, which blames phones for anxiety, populism, and polarization, despite harms being concentrated in the Anglosphere (Derek Thompson)
summary: Derek Thompson: Examining the Smartphone Theory of Everything, which blames phones for anxiety, populism, and polarization, despite harms being concentrated in the Anglosphere — Many people believe that the nexus of smartphones, Internet, and social media is to blame for every modern catastrophe.
